description: This file provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for 'input variables' in a database, using SQLAlchemy ORM. It includes functions to retrieve variables by test file or test case, create multiple variables in bulk, and delete variables associated with a test file.

methods.name: List[InputVariable] get_variables_by_test_file(db: Session, test_file_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all input variables associated with a specific test file, excluding those linked to a test case.

methods.name: List[InputVariable] get_variables_by_testcase(db: Session, test_file_id: int, testcase_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all input variables associated with a specific test case within a test file.

methods.name: List[InputVariable] create_variables_bulk(db: Session, variables: List[dict], test_file_id: int, testcase_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates multiple input variables in bulk, optionally linked to a specific test case.

methods.name: bool delete_variables_by_test_file(db: Session, test_file_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes all input variables associated with a specific test file.
